During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' served as a witness in an organized crime case, and claimed that he had helped his [[Unidentified mobster|mobster boss]] bury a fortune on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Under Oath}}</ref>
